descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Vienna puts you in the captain's seat over the real Vienna.

THE REAL VIENNA
Real satellite, elevation and map data: St. Stephen's Cathedral and its patterned roof, the Hofburg, the State Opera, the Rathaus, the Parliament, the Karlskirche, the Belvedere, Schoenbrunn and the Gloriette, the Riesenrad in the Prater, the Donauturm, the DC Tower, UNO City and the Gasometers.

THE DANUBE AND THE HILLS
Fly the Danube through the Vienna Gate between the Kahlenberg and the Bisamberg, over the vineyards and Klosterneuburg Abbey, out to Lake Neusiedl, with the Alps on the horizon.

A LIVING CITY
Trains on their real tracks, the U6 on its viaduct, boats and river cruisers on the Danube. At night the Ring lights up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, traffic calls and your landing clearance.

ENGLISH AND GERMAN
Switch every menu between English and German in Settings.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Danube, the Riesenrad out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
The Danube run, the Ringstrasse, the Vienna Woods, a fighter scramble, Vienna by night and a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
